## Hi, I'm Luca 👋

I came to Data Science in my junior year at Willamette when I declared my Major. The introductory classes for data science really drew me in with visualizing and fixing problems using data. What keeps me here is turning something messy,
like 1,000+ hand-scored tennis shots, into a clear, honest answer about
what actually predicts performance, even when that answer isn't the one
you expected going in.

At Willamette my focus has been sports analytics and reproducible data
pipelines. My [capstone](capstone.qmd), a study of what predicts
groundstroke accuracy on the Willamette Men's Tennis team, is where that
comes together: original data collection, a full R and Python pipeline,
and a result that ended up being more about experimental design than about
tennis.
